en.cmd.goto_lsp_symbol_desc: List document symbols from LSP and navigate to selected
en.cmd.show_definitions_desc: List the definitions of the symbol under the cursor (gvim addition; the native Go to Definition row jumps directly)
en.cmd.show_implementations_desc: List the implementations of the symbol under the cursor (gvim addition)
en.cmd.show_type_definitions_desc: List the type definitions of the symbol under the cursor (gvim addition)
en.status.no_language: LSP navigation: this buffer has no language
en.status.no_file: LSP navigation: this buffer has no file
en.panel.help: Up/Down: move  RET: jump  Esc: cancel
en.cmd.show_workspace_symbols_desc: List symbols from all files across the workspace
en.cmd.show_incoming_calls_desc: List callers of the function under cursor (Call Hierarchy)
en.cmd.show_outgoing_calls_desc: List functions called by the symbol under cursor (Call Hierarchy)
en.status.no_call_hierarchy: No call hierarchy available for symbol at cursor
